## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [僧伽婆羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E4%BC%BD%E5%A9%86%E7%BE%85) Saṃghabhara (the great Liáng-dynasty Cambodian translator) treats the *shí fǎ* 十法 ("Ten Dharmas") of the Mahāyāna — i.e. the ten foundational doctrinal categories of the bodhisattva path. Later incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* as assembly 9 (*Dà chéng shí fǎ huì* 大乘十法會).

**Abstract**

[僧伽婆羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E4%BC%BD%E5%A9%86%E7%BE%85) Saṃghabhara (Sēngjiāpóluó 僧伽婆羅, fl. early 6th c., a Funanese / Cambodian translator at the Liáng 梁 court of [蕭衍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%95%AD%E8%A1%8D) Wǔdì 武帝) was a major translator of Yogācāra-Mahāyāna texts. The translation is conventionally dated to the period 506 – 524 CE, his Liáng-period activity. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The Taishō text (T0314) is established on the standard apparatus.
